landing.heroDescription: Transform your photos into detailed 3D models with a single click.
landing.catalogDescription: Create and manage your 3D model catalog easily and intuitively.
landing.customizationDescription: Customize your 3D models to fit your specific needs.
landing.featuresTitle: Discover the powerful features of goto3d
landing.feature1Description: Use our advanced photogrammetry technology to transform a series of photos into a detailed 3D model. Just take some photos of the object from different angles and let goto3d do the rest.
landing.feature2Description: Organize and manage your 3D models in an interactive, easy-to-navigate catalog. Showcase your products engagingly, allowing customers to explore them from every angle.
landing.feature3Description: Edit and customize your 3D models directly in the app. Change colors, textures, and details to adapt each model to your specific needs or customer requests.
landing.feature4Description: Access and manage your 3D models wherever you are with our optimized mobile app. Capture photos, create models, and update your catalog directly from your smartphone or tablet.
landing.bannerDescription: With goto3d, bring your objects to life from simple photos, create a stunning 3D catalog and customize your models like never before.

photoGuide.staticObjects: Choose static objects that don't bend or deform while taking photos.
photoGuide.noMovingParts: Choose objects without moving or removable parts.
photoGuide.noReflective: Choose objects without reflective or transparent parts.
photoGuide.withDetails: Choose objects with well-defined details and textures.
photoGuide.objectSizeDesc: You can photograph objects of various sizes, as long as they can be framed entirely by the camera.
photoGuide.moveCamera: Move the camera around the object, taking photos from different angles and heights,
photoGuide.turntable: Place the object on a turntable and rotate it while taking photos.
photoGuide.tip: You can move the object between shots to photograph all sides, as long as it doesn't bend or deform.
photoGuide.fillFrame: Position the object so it fills as much of the camera frame as possible without excluding or cropping any part.
photoGuide.aperture: Use a sufficiently narrow aperture to maintain sharp focus. Shoot at the maximum resolution supported by the camera and use RAW format if possible.
photoGuide.avoidReflective: Avoid reflective or transparent objects, such as mirrors or glass.
photoGuide.avoidBending: Avoid objects that bend or deform during photography.
photoGuide.avoidSize: Avoid objects that are too large or too small for the camera.
photoGuide.avoidLighting: Avoid taking photos in environments that are too dark or too bright.
